baselineStrategy: Locate the code responsible for the reported behavior, make the smallest correct patch, and verify it with the available checks before finishing.

selection.primary: Number of development trials passing every independent acceptance case within all budgets.
selection.eligible: No development task may have fewer passing repetitions than baseline.
selection.tieBreak: Lower total reported provider tokens, then lower candidate index; baseline is a reference, not a generated candidate.
selection.stop: Generate at most three candidates. Stop when an eligible candidate improves development pass count; otherwise stop after three. If none is eligible select the highest development pass count, tie-breaking by tokens then index, and record the regression explicitly.
selection.holdout: Lock the selected candidate and selection receipt before any holdout model call. Evaluate baseline and selected candidate in alternating AB/BA order for each task and repetition. No further strategy generation or tuning.
selection.reliableImprovement: Complete, comparable data; higher holdout pass count; no holdout task regression; a one-sided exact sign test on per-task pass-count differences has p <= 0.05. Ties excluded. Repetitions are not independent task samples.
selection.uncertainty: Report task-level wins/losses/ties and sign-test p, paired trial outcomes, per-task regressions, token/cost/time totals. Failed, timed-out, missing-usage and invalid trials remain in the inventory. Missing/integrity-invalid evidence invalidates comparison; a valid task-budget failure is a failure.
selection.infrastructure: Provider failures, missing usage, sandbox failures, or source/evaluator drift invalidate the affected experiment. Preserve them and start a separately named frozen experiment after fixing the cause; never silently retry or delete a trial.

isolation.candidateSurface: A UTF-8 strategy string only; no executable strategy plugins.
isolation.solver: SparkAgentLoop with fenced Spark Files read/edit/grep/find plus public verify and diff. No shell, network, evaluator, Git history, or other trials.
isolation.execution: Candidate modules are bundled with allowlisted source/dependency resolution and run under macOS sandbox-exec. Hidden expected values remain in the trusted parent; the child sees one input and returns observed output.
isolation.generator: Only development prompts, public traces, failed acceptance identifiers, and metrics; no holdout prompts, tests, expected outputs, or source access.

scope: A small retrospective within-repository strategy experiment. Public historical fixes may have appeared in model training. This does not demonstrate RSI, autonomous promotion, or broad coding ability.
cost: Provider-reported usage priced by the frozen Spark/pi-ai catalog; estimated USD, not an invoice. OAuth subscription billed amount is unavailable and recorded as null. The Codex transport rejects temperature, so it is consistently omitted. It does not send max_output_tokens; maxOutputTokens is a post-response acceptance ceiling, while the wall deadline, request count, and conservative token reservation bound execution. Overshoots remain recorded failures.
